title: Present status of prostate cancer diagnosis, limitations, challenges, and future endeavors.
snippet: In addition to traditional testing methods, the use of PSMA-directed imaging to guide biopsy procedures using Multiparametric Magnetic Resonance Imaging (mpMRI) allows for better localization and characterization of lesions.
